nuggets.text: Javon Tracy set a Gophers record with two punt-return touchdowns in the opener, going 87 and 69 yards against Eastern Illinois.
Darius Taylor became just the second running back in Gophers history to reach 100 career catches.
Drake Lindsey's grandfather, Jim Lindsey, played running back for the Minnesota Vikings after playing at Arkansas.
The Gophers are hosting an SEC team for the first time since 1959, when they beat Vanderbilt 20-6.
P.J. Fleck coaches in a dress shirt, slacks and a tie in school colors, and has been known to crowdsurf the locker room after wins.
Whenever P.J. Fleck's teams take the field, one player carries an oar, a nod to his "Row the Boat" motto.
P.J. Fleck was the first FBS head coach born in the 1980s when Western Michigan hired him in 2012.
The names of all 87 Minnesota counties are cast in stone around Huntington Bank Stadium, each block weighing 6,500 pounds.
Huntington Bank Stadium served as the temporary home of the NFL's Minnesota Vikings for the 2014 and 2015 seasons.
The Little Brown Jug, the oldest trophy game in FBS, began as a 30-cent water jug Michigan left behind after a 6-6 tie in 1903.
